items.name: styles
items.title: Caliper UI tokens and base styles
items.description: Colour, radius, motion and density tokens, the Tailwind adapter and a small base stylesheet. Every part needs them; import them once in your global CSS. Each part brings its own stylesheet.

items.name: about-template
items.title: About template
items.description: Who is behind the product, in the order buyers and candidates check: the belief, how you got here, the numbers, how you work, the people and the next step.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: A stack of headings that each reveal their content, one open at a time.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: An inline message that keeps context and recovery beside the work.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert dialog
items.description: The Dialog surface for a decision that cannot be undone: no close button, no outside dismiss, focus starting on the safe choice.

items.name: animated-counter
items.title: Animated counter
items.description: A number that counts to its value, with prefix, suffix and locale.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect ratio
items.description: A box that keeps a fixed ratio so images and video never shift the layout.

items.name: auth-page
items.title: Auth page
items.description: A centred sign-in or sign-up page with a brand header and legal links.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A person's photo, falling back to initials when there is no image.

items.name: avatar-group
items.title: Avatar group
items.description: A compact stack of avatars with an overflow count and presence.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A small label for status, category or count.

items.name: bar-chart
items.title: Bar chart
items.description: A compact bar series with an accessible label.

items.name: blog-grid
items.title: Blog grid
items.description: A grid of article cards with date, tag and summary.

items.name: blog-post-template
items.title: Blog post template
items.description: One article at a reading measure: a progress line under the header, an outline that marks where you are, linkable headings, the author and three related posts.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: The path to the current page, with each parent linked.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A familiar action with immediate focus, a tactile press, and optional pending or label feedback that stays on the button itself.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button group
items.description: A toolbar of related tools in one raised shell; toggled tools sink into it.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month grid for choosing a day or a range, usable on its own or inside a picker.

items.name: calendar-app
items.title: Calendar app
items.description: A full calendar: day, week, month and agenda, a month picker and calendar toggles, a now line, and events you create by dragging, move by dragging or with Alt and the arrows, and edit in place.

items.name: call-to-action
items.title: Call to action
items.description: A closing band with one clear action.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A titled container with media, status, meta and optional expandable details.

items.name: changelog-template
items.title: Changelog template
items.description: What shipped, newest first: dates that stay in view, linkable versions, tag filters with a count and a product view per release.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A native checkbox with a clear checked, unchecked and indeterminate state.

items.name: chip-group
items.title: Chip group
items.description: A set of toggleable chips for single or multiple choices.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: A single disclosure for optional detail.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A searchable select with grouped options and keywords.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command palette
items.description: A searchable list of destinations and actions opened from the keyboard.

items.name: contact-section
items.title: Contact section
items.description: A contact form beside the ways to reach a team.

items.name: contact-template
items.title: Contact template
items.description: A contact page that routes the message first: pick the topic and it says who answers and how soon. The form keeps what you typed if sending fails and confirms where the reply will go.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context menu
items.description: A menu opened with a right-click or long press on a piece of content.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy button
items.description: Copies a value and confirms what was copied, with a fallback when the clipboard is blocked.

items.name: cta-block
items.title: CTA block
items.description: The closing call to action: the promise again, one specific next step and a reassurance line.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data table
items.description: Accessible table markup with consistent cell styling and a scrollable region.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date picker
items.description: A date field that opens a calendar, with min, max and today shortcuts.

items.name: date-range-picker
items.title: Date range picker
items.description: Choose a start and end date with preset ranges.

items.name: description-list
items.title: Description list
items.description: A record's details as label and value pairs, side by side when there is room, with copy and edit where the value sits.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal window that asks for a decision or a short form, with focus kept inside.

items.name: direction
items.title: Direction
items.description: Sets reading direction for everything inside it. Spacing, borders, affixes and the selected edge follow on their own; icons that point somewhere flip when marked.

items.name: donut-chart
items.title: Donut chart
items.description: Parts of a whole as a ring, with the total in the centre.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A panel that slides in from the left or right for editing alongside the page.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown menu
items.description: A menu of actions anchored to a trigger, with groups, shortcuts and separators.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty state
items.description: A message with an icon and a next step for when there is nothing to show.

items.name: error-template
items.title: Error template
items.description: The pages people land on when something goes wrong, each with the way out that fits: search, ask for access, retry with a reference, wait out maintenance, reconnect or get a new link.

items.name: faq-block
items.title: FAQ block
items.description: Searchable questions with one answer open at a time, each linking to the exact doc, and a way to ask when nothing matches.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Wraps a control with its label, hint, error and optional action, wired for assistive tech.

items.name: footer-block
items.title: Footer block
items.description: The page's last word: link columns, a newsletter that confirms in place, the legal line, status and the name as a full-width wordmark.

items.name: hold-to-confirm
items.title: Hold to confirm
items.description: Hold to confirm, part of the Actions family.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover card
items.description: A preview card that appears when hovering or focusing a link or name.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A recessed text field with optional leading and trailing affixes; it never jumps when validation appears.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Keys as small raised caps: one shortcut per kbd, ⌘ on a Mac and Ctrl elsewhere, with spoken names for symbols.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: The visible name for a field, tied to it so a click focuses the control.

items.name: legal-template
items.title: Legal template
items.description: A policy people can read: the short version first, numbered sections with an outline that follows you, linkable clauses, a change history and a print layout.

items.name: line-chart
items.title: Line chart
items.description: One or more series over time, with hover readout and an optional band.

items.name: loader
items.title: Loader
items.description: A small indeterminate indicator in four shapes.

items.name: metric
items.title: Metric
items.description: A number with its context, change and a small trend line.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation menu
items.description: A site header whose items open frosted panels of links. Hover waits for intent, the panel resizes from one item to the next, and every link is reachable by keyboard.

items.name: newsletter-signup
items.title: Newsletter signup
items.description: An email field with consent and success states.

items.name: not-found-page
items.title: Not found page
items.description: A friendly 404 with suggestions and search.

items.name: number-field
items.title: Number field
items.description: A numeric field with steppers, limits, a suffix and optional drag-to-scrub.

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTP input
items.description: A segmented field for one-time codes with paste support and status.

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page header
items.description: A title with description, breadcrumbs and actions.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page links with previous and next, sized for touch.

items.name: password-field
items.title: Password field
items.description: A password input with a show and hide control.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A small panel anchored to a trigger for quick settings or details.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A measured bar for work with a known size, such as an upload.

items.name: prose
items.title: Prose
items.description: Spacing, a readable measure and quiet links for long-form markup you do not control, such as a Markdown render, release notes or a legal page.

items.name: radio
items.title: Radio
items.description: A native radio for choosing exactly one option from a short group.

items.name: rating
items.title: Rating
items.description: Stars that are a native radio group: arrows change the value, a pointer previews, half steps when you need them, and a read-only average that says how many ratings it comes from.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll area
items.description: A labelled, keyboard-focusable scroll region with a quiet scrollbar.

items.name: search
items.title: Search
items.description: A search field with a clear button and the right keyboard on phones.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented control
items.description: Segmented control, part of the Blocks family.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A styled native select for choosing one option from a short list.

items.name: select-menu
items.title: Select menu
items.description: A select whose list opens with the chosen option over the trigger; the platform picker on touch.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A 1px divider in the toolbar's own hairline, with a labelled form for “or continue with email”. Decoration unless you say otherwise.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: A collapsible navigation rail for an app's main sections.

items.name: sign-in-form
items.title: Sign in form
items.description: An email and password form with provider buttons and clear errors.

items.name: site-footer
items.title: Site footer
items.description: Link columns, social links and legal text.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A placeholder with the shape of the content it stands in for.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A native range input styled to match, with accessible value text.

items.name: sparkline
items.title: Sparkline
items.description: A tiny trend line with no axes, for use inside text and tables.

items.name: split-button
items.title: Split button
items.description: A primary action joined to its alternatives; the chosen option becomes the label.

items.name: stat-card
items.title: Stat card
items.description: A bordered figure with a label, description and change.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: Shows where someone is in a multi-step flow and lets them go back.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Switch, part of the Inputs family.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Switch between related views of the same content without leaving the page.

items.name: team-block
items.title: Team block
items.description: People introduced by what they own and how to reach them, with their photo or, when there is none, their initials.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A recessed multi-line field that grows with the draft from 3 to 8 lines.

items.name: theme-switch
items.title: Theme switch
items.description: A light and dark toggle that changes at once or reveals the new theme with a circle, seam or wipe.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: A short, dismissible message that confirms an action, with an optional undo.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle and toggle group
items.description: A button that stays pressed, alone or in a raised group that holds one choice or many and moves with the arrow keys as a single tab stop.

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: Tools with one tab stop: arrows move between them, toggles sit recessed, and when the row runs out of width the last tools fold into a More menu with their state.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short hint that appears on hover or focus, never the only way to learn something.

items.name: user-menu
items.title: User menu
items.description: A dropdown for the signed-in person's identity and account actions.
